newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Styl hits new high after 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Styl hits new high after 1996 results.

text.p: Hungarian garment factory Styl Ruhagyar Rt's shares jumped to a new record high on Tuesday following the publication of the company's 1996 figures but traders doubted that the steep rise stemmed from the results.
Traders said that less liquid stocks like Styl can easily move in only a few deals.
"It was not evident that Styl rose because of the results," one trader said. "Small investors might buy it," another said.
Styl shares opened at 1,810 forints, above Monday's close of 1,650 and jumped to a new record high of 1,825 forints. At 1152 GMT it traded at 1,750 forints.
So far today only six deals have been made for a total of 270 shares.

Styl released its 1996 earnings report on Tuesday morning and said its operating profit of 435.2 million forints represented 99 percent of last year's figure, while its pre-tax profit of 342.1 million was 13.4 percent above 1995 figures.
